user.title: Aurora Energy (Aurora+) Setup
user.description:
**How to get your ID Token:**

1. Open [https://my.auroraenergy.com.au](https://my.auroraenergy.com.au) in your browser
2. Press **F12** to open DevTools, then go to the **Network** tab
3. Log in to Aurora+ (tick **Keep me logged in**)
4. In the Network tab, filter by `LoginToken`
5. Click the `LoginToken` request → **Request Payload**
6. Copy the `token` value — a long string starting with `eyJ`

**Important:** Have this screen ready before you log in — the token expires within minutes of login.

data_description.id_token: Paste the token value from the LoginToken network request (starts with eyJ)
